Use case: precise-object-edit.
Revise this exact Threadbound full-outfit T-pose to match the user's feedback. Preserve the blank-head pale lacquered boy doll, proportions, T-pose, framing, white background, brown forearm wraps, closed-toe boots, charcoal palette, sash and outfit identity.

CRITICAL LOWER BODY CORRECTION: REPLACE the long pants with RAGGED KNEE-LENGTH BREECHES. The upper trousers run from the waist down to the knees, then END in uneven torn hems. A few short ragged cloth points overlap the TOPS of the knee joints, as if the lower pants were torn away. Most of each pale wooden kneecap and hinge stays plainly visible. BELOW BOTH KNEES there is NO PANTS FABRIC AT ALL. Remove the separate calf trouser sections entirely. Show bare pale wooden knees and a short length of upper shin between the torn breeches and the calf-high boot tops. Do not make holes with reinforced oval rims, and do not restart cloth below the knees. Boots remain closed-toe brown leather and stop BELOW knees. No bare toes.

RAGGED CLOTHING: Make the tunic skirt hem and short sleeve ends more weathered and irregular, with torn short points, fraying, a few small nicks and missing cloth bites. Keep the main garment substantial and wearable, not a shredded cape or dozens of long strips. Tunic panels end around mid thigh and never conceal the knees. Keep elbow joints exposed between upper sleeves and forearm bracers; wrists and all doll fingers remain bare.

COWL: retain short folded charcoal scarf collar, add lightly frayed worn edges. NO HOOD, NO SCARF TAILS or hanging scarf ends. Cowl ends on upper chest.

ONE full front orthographic T-pose figure only, blank oval stitched head with NO EYES, same subtly masculine straight waist and compact hips. Clear construction illustration, precise contours, controlled painted shading and neutral diffuse light. No weapons, side views, text, watermark or ground shadow. This is the revised fit reference for a ragged starter outfit, especially torn-off breeches with NO lower trouser sections.
assets.role: review-only revised fit reference; not a generation input
